title: Grateful Dead Live at Baton Rouge International Speedway on 1969-09-01
taper: Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear)
source: Bear's Ampex Cassette Master > DAT > CD > WAV (provided by Anon)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a strong 1969 Baton Rouge show with standout Easy Wind and Lovelight, despite brief distortion and a missing Dark Star intro.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its powerful Jerry‑centric tunes – especially Easy Wind, Lovelight and a fiery Dark Star – with Tom Constanten’s keyboards adding an Iron‑Butterfly‑like texture. The soundboard recording is generally excellent, though reviewers note a small distortion at 9:45 in Lovelight and the loss of the opening fragment of Dark Star.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (mostly 5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and sound quality, with only minor technical flaws lowering the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall excellent clarity and balance; a brief distortion around 9:45 in Lovelight and loss of the opening segment of Dark Star are the only noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with strong Jerry‑lead tunes and seamless transitions, especially into Lovelight; the band explores each tune deeply, creating a vivid 'Cajun Dead' vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers a powerful performance, highlighted on Easy Wind and Lovelight – praised as 'Captain Trips' material.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) provides lush, Iron‑Butterfly‑like keyboard textures that thrive during this 1969 period.
